title: Galois and Frobenius facts for an arbitrary finite field extension
statement:
Let $K\hookrightarrow L$ be an extension of finite fields [def-weil-finite-field-q-elements, def-pc-field-extension], put $q=|K|$ and $r=[L:K]=\dim_K L$ [def-weil-vector-space-dimension]. The extension $L/K$ is Galois: it is separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension] and the minimal polynomial over $K$ of every element of $L$ splits into linear factors over $L$. Write $\operatorname{Gal}(L/K)$ for the group of field automorphisms of $L$ fixing $K$. The map $F:L\to L$, $F(x)=x^q$, is in this group, has order $r$, and the map
$$\{0,\ldots,r-1\}\longrightarrow\operatorname{Gal}(L/K),\qquad j\longmapsto F^j$$
is bijective.
